records.name: Inline fraction, subscript and superscript survive prose formatting
Chinese punctuation stays attached to the preceding inline formula
Matrix alignment and escaped HTML have identical static/client markup
Mathematical brackets cannot become Markdown links
Math asterisks cannot become bold markup
Inline code retains math delimiters and Python subscripts literally
All four authored delimiters use one rendering path
Prose emphasis and internal links remain usable around math
Link labels can contain math without leaking an internal placeholder
Link labels preserve inline code and keep its HTML escaped
Code and math are never recursively interpreted
A malformed expression fails the build rather than silently showing red TeX
Shape notation renders math while tensor layouts retain code styling
Search snippets retain Greek symbols without exposing TeX source
Plain search text preserves fractions, scripts, roots and matrix rows
Exercise paragraphs preserve the authored input/edge-case separation
Display math is keyboard focusable and has a contained scroll box
